settings.api_url.label: Mihomo API URL
settings.api_url.description: URL of the Mihomo external control API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9090).
settings.api_secret.label: API Secret
settings.api_secret.description: Bearer token for the Mihomo API. Leave empty if the API is unauthenticated.
settings.stack.label: Default TUN Stack
settings.stack.description: Stack used when left-clicking the widget to enable TUN mode.
